Use case: product-mockup.
Create a NEW design from scratch, square fantasy RPG inventory icon of an absurdly expensive couture perfume by Grey Wiese. This should look like the centerpiece of a royal private perfume collection, confident maximalist luxury with exquisite refined execution.
One complete bottle centered on near-black muted teal studio backdrop, generous 10% margins. Tall elegant architectural silhouette with gently tapered shoulders, thick flawless smoked midnight crystal, champagne amber perfume visible inside, polished gold base and narrow gold neck. The cap is a sculptural golden crown formed from two elegant sweeping elven wings, beautifully proportioned. On the bottle front a HUGE bespoke intertwined GW gold heraldic monogram in raised metal, with tasteful symmetrical gold flourishes and small crown above. Under the monogram an ivory-black inset label with exact text "GREY WIESE" in sophisticated widely spaced high-contrast serif capitals. Make this branding deliberate, crisp, central and exceptionally flamboyant. Monogram fills half the bottle front and is legible in small thumbnail.
Premium cinematic product illustration, clean realistic glass optics, controlled warm gold rim lights, luxurious restrained deep shadows, polished surfaces, exceptionally clean edges and coherent geometry. Nearly frontal slight three-quarter view; whole object visible. Readable at 80px as a fantasy game item. No people, hands, package, flowers, props, room, watermarks, image frame, tiny noisy patterns, glitter noise, melted ornament or broken letters. Do not make a squat chunky green gemstone potion bottle.
